info.name: Ektrepha Parent App — Account, Profile, Children, Bookings, Nanny (local)
info.description:
Every endpoint built for the Parent-Side Profile & Booking Surfaces PRD: Account (A1-A6), Parent Profile + Address Book (P1-P4), Child Profiles (C1-C6), Bookings read-side (B1/B2/H1/H2), and Nanny public profile/verification/reviews (S1/S2). Run top-to-bottom within 'Setup' first to populate accessToken/accessToken2. The 'Bookings' and 'Nanny Profile' folders need testNannyId/testBookingId populated manually (seed via SQL) since there is no API yet to create a nanny or a real booking (POST /bookings is still a placeholder stub) — those requests are written to pass with either 200 or 404 so the collection still runs clean unseeded, but you won't see a real payload until you set those two variables.

Booking write actions (cancel, contact, rebook) and Leave Review are NOT in this collection — not built yet (see docs/test-cases/ for what's covered vs. blocked).

variable.description: Set manually — no API creates a nanny yet. Seed one via SQL (see docs/test-cases/nanny-profile-and-verification.md) and paste its id here.
Set manually — POST /bookings is still a placeholder stub. Seed a real booking row via SQL and paste its id here.
